Merge pull request #37 from hadarkamer/feature/all-watch-scan-prior-price-20260913

Add causal BTC context for 106 all-Watch formulas

checks.query:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id,usable_from_utc
    FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC LIMIT 128
), windows AS (
    SELECT i.snapshot_set_id,i.usable_from_utc,date_trunc('minute',i.usable_from_utc) AS boundary,
        t.name,t.minutes,t.feature,f.payload->'btc_context_provenance' AS context,
        f.payload#>'{btc_context_provenance,windows}'->t.name AS proof
    FROM recent i JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples f USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('1h',60,'historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction'),
        ('4h',240,'historical.closed_1m.4h.btc_market_regime')) t(name,minutes,feature)
    WHERE f.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND f.status='READY' AND f.symbol='BTC'
), raw AS (
    SELECT w.*,a.*,
        100.0*(a.last_close/a.first_open-1.0) AS raw_return,
        100.0*(a.raw_high-a.raw_low)/a.first_open AS raw_range
    FROM windows w CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT count(*) AS n,min(open_time_utc) AS first_time,max(close_time_utc) AS last_time,
            (array_agg(open ORDER BY open_time_utc))[1] AS first_open,
            (array_agg(close ORDER BY open_time_utc DESC))[1] AS last_close,
            max(high) AS raw_high,min(low) AS raw_low
        FROM research_price_archive_bars b
        WHERE b.route='BINANCE_SPOT_TRADE_1M' AND b.symbol='BTC'
            AND b.open_time_utc>=w.boundary-w.minutes*interval '1 minute'
            AND b.open_time_utc<w.boundary
            AND b.close_time_utc<w.boundary
    ) a
), checked AS (
    SELECT *,CASE WHEN name='1h' THEN CASE WHEN raw_return>0 THEN 'UP'
        WHEN raw_return<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'FLAT' END
        WHEN raw_range<=0 OR abs(raw_return)/NULLIF(raw_range,0)<0.5 THEN 'RANGE'
        WHEN raw_return>0 THEN 'UP' WHEN raw_return<0 THEN 'DOWN' ELSE 'RANGE' END AS raw_feature
    FROM raw
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT snapshot_set_id) AS audited_scans,count(*) AS audited_windows,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status'='READY') AS frozen_ready_windows,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE n=minutes) AS current_cache_complete_windows,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'
        AND n>COALESCE((proof->>'path_samples')::int,0)) AS partial_windows_with_more_bars_now,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status'='READY' AND (
        n<>minutes OR (proof->>'path_samples')::int IS DISTINCT FROM n
        OR (proof->>'expected_candles')::int IS DISTINCT FROM minutes
        OR (proof->>'path_complete')::boolean IS DISTINCT FROM true
        OR first_time IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-minutes*interval '1 minute'
        OR last_time IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-interval '1 millisecond')) AS ready_count_mismatches,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE (context->>'cutoff_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary
        OR (proof->>'window_start_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-minutes*interval '1 minute'
        OR (proof->>'window_end_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM boundary-interval '1 millisecond'
        OR (proof->>'event_time_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc) AS boundary_mismatches,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status'='READY' AND (
        (abs((proof->>'return_pct')::double precision-raw_return)<=1e-10) IS NOT TRUE
        OR (abs((proof->>'range_pct')::double precision-raw_range)<=1e-10) IS NOT TRUE
        OR (proof->>'first_open')::double precision IS DISTINCT FROM first_open
        OR (proof->>'last_close')::double precision IS DISTINCT FROM last_close
        OR (proof->>'high')::double precision IS DISTINCT FROM raw_high
        OR (proof->>'low')::double precision IS DISTINCT FROM raw_low)) AS ready_statistics_mismatches,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status'='READY'
        AND context->'features'->>feature IS DISTINCT FROM raw_feature) AS ready_feature_mismatches,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE proof->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'READY'
        AND context->'features' ? feature) AS unavailable_as_known,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE context->>'price_route' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BINANCE_SPOT_TRADE_1M'
        OR proof#>>'{source,symbol}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BTC'
        OR proof#>>'{source,exchange}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'binance'
        OR proof#>>'{source,market}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'spot'
        OR proof#>>'{source,pair}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BTCUSDT') AS source_route_mismatches
FROM checked

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT * FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC LIMIT 128
), rows AS (
    SELECT i.snapshot_set_id,i.consumer_version,i.source_version,i.bundle_sha256,
        i.parent_payload_sha256,i.usable_from_utc,f.symbol,f.payload,
        f.payload->'btc_context_provenance' AS context
    FROM recent i LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples f
        ON f.consumer_version=i.consumer_version AND f.snapshot_set_id=i.snapshot_set_id
        AND f.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND f.status='READY'
), per_scan AS (
    SELECT snapshot_set_id,count(symbol) AS coins,count(DISTINCT symbol) AS distinct_coins,
        count(DISTINCT context->>'context_sha256') AS hashes,count(DISTINCT context) AS contexts,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE symbol IS NOT NULL AND (
            (context->>'context_sha256' ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') IS NOT TRUE
            OR context->>'version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'watch-prior-btc-spot-closed-1m-v1'
            OR context->>'consumer_version' IS DISTINCT FROM consumer_version
            OR (context->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id
            OR context->>'source_version' IS DISTINCT FROM source_version
            OR context->>'population_version' IS DISTINCT FROM 'watch-all-scan-observations-v1'
            OR context->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256
            OR context->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256::text
            OR (context->>'usable_from_utc')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM usable_from_utc
            OR payload->>'bundle_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM bundle_sha256
            OR payload->>'parent_payload_sha256' IS DISTINCT FROM parent_payload_sha256::text
            OR payload->>'symbol' IS DISTINCT FROM symbol
            OR (payload->>'snapshot_set_id')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM snapshot_set_id
            OR payload#>'{features_by_direction,LONG,features,historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction}'
                IS DISTINCT FROM context#>'{features,historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction}'
            OR payload#>'{features_by_direction,SHORT,features,historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction}'
                IS DISTINCT FROM context#>'{features,historical.closed_1m.1h.btc_direction}'
            OR payload#>'{features_by_direction,LONG,features,historical.closed_1m.4h.btc_market_regime}'
                IS DISTINCT FROM context#>'{features,historical.closed_1m.4h.btc_market_regime}'
            OR payload#>'{features_by_direction,SHORT,features,historical.closed_1m.4h.btc_market_regime}'
                IS DISTINCT FROM context#>'{features,historical.closed_1m.4h.btc_market_regime}'
        )) AS identity_or_feature_mismatches
    FROM rows GROUP BY snapshot_set_id
)
SELECT count(*) AS accepted_scans_checked,sum(coins) AS ready_coins,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE coins<>8 OR distinct_coins<>8) AS incomplete_scans,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE coins>0 AND (hashes<>1 OR contexts<>1)) AS shared_context_mismatches,
    sum(identity_or_feature_mismatches) AS identity_or_feature_mismatches
FROM per_scan

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC LIMIT 128
), paired AS (
    SELECT a.consumer_version,a.snapshot_set_id,a.symbol,a.payload->'evaluations' AS old_evaluations,
        b.payload->'evaluations' AS new_evaluations
    FROM recent i JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples a USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples b
        ON b.consumer_version=a.consumer_version AND b.snapshot_set_id=a.snapshot_set_id AND b.symbol=a.symbol
        AND b.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND b.status='READY'
    WHERE a.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain' AND a.status='READY'
), compared AS (
    SELECT p.*,x.retained,x.n FROM paired p CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(e.value ORDER BY e.ordinality) AS retained,count(*) AS n
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(p.new_evaluations,'[]'::jsonb)) WITH ORDINALITY e(value,ordinality)
        JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_catalog c ON c.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v2-maxpain'
            AND c.supported AND c.candidate_key=e.value->>'candidate_key'
    ) x
)
SELECT count(*) AS old_coin_samples_checked,count(DISTINCT snapshot_set_id) AS scans_checked,
    sum(n) AS retained_old_decisions,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE new_evaluations IS NULL) AS missing_v3_samples,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE n<>164 OR jsonb_array_length(old_evaluations)<>164) AS coverage_mismatches,
    count(*) FILTER(WHERE old_evaluations IS DISTINCT FROM retained) AS exact_json_mismatches
FROM compared

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT consumer_version,snapshot_set_id FROM research_watch_scan_intakes
    WHERE consumer_version='watch-all-scan-intake-v1' AND intake_status='ACCEPTED'
    ORDER BY snapshot_set_id DESC LIMIT 128
), versions AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS samples,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='READY') AS ready,count(*) FILTER(WHERE status='ERROR') AS errors,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE next_attempt_at_utc IS NOT NULL) AS pending
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_samples GROUP BY evaluation_version
), evaluations AS (
    SELECT evaluation_version,count(*) AS decisions,count(DISTINCT candidate_key) AS candidates
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations_by_version GROUP BY evaluation_version
), current_rows AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS decisions,count(DISTINCT evaluation_version) AS versions,
        count(DISTINCT candidate_key) AS candidates,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE evaluation_version IS DISTINCT FROM 'watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context') AS wrong_version,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE qualifies_as_prospective_formula_evidence) AS prospective_rows
    FROM research_watch_scan_formula_evaluations
), hype AS (
    SELECT f.payload->'btc_context_provenance' AS context,m.symbol AS measured_symbol,
        m.price_route,m.payload->>'price_route' AS payload_price_route
    FROM recent i JOIN research_watch_scan_formula_samples f USING(consumer_version,snapshot_set_id)
    LEFT JOIN research_watch_scan_measurements m
        ON m.consumer_version=f.consumer_version AND m.snapshot_set_id=f.snapshot_set_id AND m.symbol=f.symbol
        AND m.measurement_version='watch-scan-measurements-v1'
    WHERE f.evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context' AND f.status='READY' AND f.symbol='HYPE'
), hype_counts AS (
    SELECT count(*) AS samples,count(*) FILTER(WHERE measured_symbol IS NULL) AS missing_measurements,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE context->>'price_route' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BINANCE_SPOT_TRADE_1M'
            OR context#>>'{windows,1h,source,symbol}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BTC'
            OR context#>>'{windows,4h,source,symbol}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'BTC'
            OR context#>>'{windows,1h,source,market}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'spot'
            OR context#>>'{windows,4h,source,market}' IS DISTINCT FROM 'spot') AS bad_context_source,
        count(*) FILTER(WHERE measured_symbol IS NOT NULL AND (
            price_route IS DISTINCT FROM 'HYPERLIQUID_HYPE_PERP_TRADE_1M'
            OR payload_price_route IS DISTINCT FROM 'HYPERLIQUID_HYPE_PERP_TRADE_1M')) AS bad_outcome_route
    FROM hype
)
SELECT (SELECT active_evaluation_version FROM research_watch_scan_formula_runtime WHERE singleton=true) AS active_version,
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(v) ORDER BY evaluation_version) FROM versions v) AS sample_counts,
    (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(e) ORDER BY evaluation_version) FROM evaluations e) AS by_version_evaluations,
    (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM current_rows c) AS current_evaluations,
    (SELECT to_jsonb(h) FROM hype_counts h) AS hype,
    (SELECT jsonb_build_object('total',count(*),'supported',count(*) FILTER(WHERE supported),
        'unsupported',count(*) FILTER(WHERE NOT supported)) FROM research_watch_scan_formula_catalog
        WHERE evaluation_version='watch-scan-formulas-v3-btc-context') AS v3_catalog
